question: A shopkeeper has five deliveries of different varieties of dry fruits- cashew nuts, almonds, pistachios, walnuts, and pine nuts- each delivery planned on a different date, viz- 1st, 6th, 12th, 20th and 30th of July 2022. The delivery of pine nuts is planned exactly after the delivery of almonds, which is planned exactly after the delivery of pistachios. The delivery of cashew nuts is planned exactly between the deliveries of pine nuts and walnuts. If the delivery of walnuts is the last delivery planned, on which date is the delivery of almonds planned?
